# Categorical status matrix

Contents: [Use cases](#use-cases), [Chart IDs](#chart-ids), [Minimal spec](#minimal-spec), [Data](#data), [Options](#options), [Annotations](#annotations), [Sizing](#sizing), [Fixtures](#fixtures), [Not for](#not-for).

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-reference.mjs from the boardplot describe, list and fixtures payloads. -->

Entity × period matrix with discrete semantic states, visible sparse cells, and truthful state keys. Type `status`.

## Use cases

- Project status by period
- RAG matrix
- Milestone tracking

## Chart IDs

One form; its chart ID is `status`.

## Minimal spec

```json
{
  "type": "status",
  "data": {
    "rows": [{ "id": "pricing", "label": "Pricing" }, { "id": "service", "label": "Service" }],
    "columns": [{ "id": "design", "label": "Design" }, { "id": "pilot", "label": "Pilot" }],
    "cells": [
      { "row": "pricing", "col": "design", "state": "done" },
      { "row": "pricing", "col": "pilot", "state": "open" },
      { "row": "service", "col": "design", "state": "open" }
    ]
  },
  "options": {
    "states": [
      { "id": "done", "label": "Done", "tone": "good" },
      { "id": "open", "label": "Open", "tone": "neutral" }
    ],
    "title": "Pricing design is done; pilot work remains open",
    "source": "Illustrative data"
  }
}
```

## Data

A `cell` is a number, null or a value object; see [Value cell](options.md#value-cell).

| Path | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| rows | array | yes | Matrix rows displayed in the supplied order. |
| rows[].id | string | yes | Unique matrix-row identity referenced by cells. |
| rows[].label | string |  | Displayed matrix-row name; defaults to its id. |
| columns | array | yes | Matrix columns displayed in the supplied order. |
| columns[].id | string | yes | Unique matrix-column identity referenced by cells. |
| columns[].label | string |  | Displayed matrix-column name; defaults to its id. |
| cells | array | yes | Unique row/column bindings to declared states; unbound positions remain missing. |
| cells[].row | string | yes | Id of the matrix row containing this cell. |
| cells[].col | string | yes | Id of the matrix column containing this cell. |
| cells[].state | string | yes | Id of a state declared in options.states. |
| cells[].value | cell |  | Optional value printed under the state label, or alone when the cell is too small for both. A value object can set its own format, such as { number: 97.5, format: '1.0%' }. |

## Options

| Path | Type | Values | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| labels | false \| object | `false` (or another value of its type) |  | False hides cell state and value labels. Row and stage names remain. series: false hides row names; category: false hides stage names. When the state key is drawn and colour or hatch tells the states apart, the key names them and the cells print no state names, unless labelDensity is 'full'; then names that fit no type step print, and the rest warn label-hidden. Otherwise state names print in every bound cell only when all of them fit; else the key names states. |
| legend | string \| object | `'top'`, `'bottom'`, `'none'` (or another value of its type) |  | State-legend placement, or none to suppress the legend while cells name every used state. A required key remains when cell state names are not drawn, including a one-state matrix. A grid panel's explicit none leaves the state key with the host. |
| legend.position | string | `'top'`, `'bottom'` |  | Place the categorical state legend at the top or bottom. |
| states | array |  |  | One to six declared categorical states defining cell meaning, legend labels and paint. |
| states[].id | string |  |  | Unique state identity referenced by matrix cells. |
| states[].label | string |  |  | Visible state name used by the legend and the accessible description. The description lists each state with its cell count, as 'On track 12', then 'No status 3' for empty cells; the reading carries each count as a derived claim with that text. |
| states[].tone | string \| object | `'good'`, `'bad'`, `'neutral'`, `'warn'`, `'info'` (or another value of its type) |  | Semantic verdict tone, or an explicit theme role for the state fill. |
| states[].tone.role | string |  |  | Named semantic theme color role for this state. |
| states[].pattern | string | `'hatch45'` |  | Optional 45-degree hatching to distinguish this state beyond color. |
| columnLabels | string | `'top'`, `'bottom'` | `'top'` | Column-caption position; defaults to top. |

Plus the [shared options](options.md). This type does not accept `detailFields`, `categoryLabels`, `valueAxis`, `categoryAxis`, `secondaryAxis`, `rowLabels`, `sort`, `topN`, `bandFraction`, `rounding`.

## Annotations

This type takes no annotations.

## Sizing

Floor 280 × 28 px; fit `content`.

Below the floor a render is refused with `size-below-floor` and the pixels it needs. `measure` returns the natural and comfortable size for a given spec; see [Sizing in the manual](../manual.md#sizing).

## Not for

Numeric magnitudes; status cells hold discrete states.
